messages:
Jamie Liang: Heads-up: planning rollout for routing-policy v3 (canary -> A/B). Need final list of telemetry signals and the safety gate logic.
Noah Patel: We should guard on p95 latency, 5xx rate, and per-route quality metric (embedding drift or answer-similarity). Keep thresholds conservative.
Sara Gomez: Agreed. Also split by customer_tier (free/prod) since latency impact on enterprise customers matters more. Alert only when sustained.
Ali Chen: Add token-cost-per-call too. We had a case where model changed generation length and cost spiked. Proposed thresholds: p95 +15%, 5xx +1.5pp, cost +25%.
Jamie Liang: UX decision: Console should show a compact canary vs baseline comparison (side-by-side sparklines + single-line delta). Ops wants a 1-click rollback and a quick-inspect panel.
Noah Patel: Rollback must be atomic: revert traffic split and surface the exact commit + model version in the audit event. Also include sampled failing requests so SRE can triage.
Ali Chen: Backend note: telemetry includes rollout_id and cohort tag. We can compute deltas in metrics-store. For request samples we need a deterministic sampler that increases retention for errors and high-latency items.
Sara Gomez: Alerting: prefer a composite rule to reduce noise. Example: (p95_delta > 1.15 AND err_delta > 0.01) OR (quality_delta < -0.03). Use moving-window logic (evaluate 5m window, require 3 windows).
Noah Patel: Sample PromQL-style rule for detection:
```
avg_over_time(canary_p95[5m]) / avg_over_time(baseline_p95[5m]) > 1.15 and
(avg_over_time(canary_5xx[5m]) - avg_over_time(baseline_5xx[5m])) > 0.01
```
Fire if this holds for 3 consecutive 1m evaluations.
Jamie Liang: How do we display diagnostics? My idea: an expandable "Diagnostics" panel in the rollout detail that shows 5 representative requests (redacted), stack traces or runtime stderr excerpts, and a small histogram of latencies.
Ali Chen: I'll add an internal endpoint: /internal/rollouts/{id}/samples?cohort=canary that returns redacted payloads + inference-logs. Will enforce ACLs and 10 req/min rate cap.
Sara Gomez: Also show the traffic-split timeline (annotated): percent over time + markings for autoscale/fallback events. That helps tell if latency is capacity-related.
Noah Patel: Small improvement: mark deltas that are statistically significant using CI (bootstrap) instead of raw percent to avoid flipping on small-sample noise. Color = red/yellow/green based on significance and effect size.

Jamie Liang: Action items: Ali -> samples API + redact rules; Noah -> prototype CI-based alert thresholds and add to alerting repo; Sara -> mock Console diff + diagnostics panel and timeline; I'll write brief runbook for on-call.
Ali Chen: ETA: samples endpoint pre-prod by EOD tomorrow. Will post ACL list.
Noah Patel: I'll post draft alert rules to #eng-sre and tag on-call for review.
Sara Gomez: Posting Figma mockups later today. Will include quick-rollback flows and sample inspector. :thumbsup: 
Jamie Liang: If no objections to composite gates I'll lock the rule set and schedule a 20m sync tomorrow 11:00 to sign off.
